author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC-Auto: Label-free per-PC adaptive selection (plateau rule)
abstract: Dual BRBG with auto-selected per-PC adaptive residualization parameters using a label-free plateau rule on post-residualization batch predictability (mean R^2). Embedding = ComBat+PCA64; graph = adaptive residualized PCs (50) + balanced kNN (k=48, cosine).
